answer: The oasis schedule is applied in thread and marble exposes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 55% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3033 identities would post 1051 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
